description.subject: A crocheted amigurumi figure made of yarn, standing upright with a round off-white head and a small stitched smile.
description.covering: A crimson crocheted hooded dress with long sleeves, a ruffled flared skirt and a drawstring at the neck, worn over short off-white legs and brown crocheted boots.
description.setting: Outdoors on a bed of smooth, rounded beach pebbles in tan, brown, grey and white, in front of a dark metal slatted park bench.
description.light: Soft, even, slightly warm light from the front and above, with gentle contrast and no hard edges.
description.materials: Crocheted wool or cotton yarn, polished stone pebbles, painted metal bench slats, and amber-coloured glass or resin beads.
description.anomaly: Two round, amber-brown translucent beads, like faceted glass buttons, are fastened to the front of the red dress and hang at the ends of the hood's twisted drawstring cords.
